public_case.question: 怎样获取Commercial区域库存量前十的产品及其当前库存量？

source_gold_sql:
WITH commercial_stores AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM toy_stores
    WHERE store_location = 'Commercial'
),

-- 关联库存表并聚合库存量
inventory_aggregation AS (
    SELECT 
        i.product_id,
        SUM(CAST(i.stock_on_hand AS BIGINT)) AS total_stock
    FROM toy_inventory i
    INNER JOIN commercial_stores cs 
        ON i.store_id = cs.store_id
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),

-- 关联商品表获取商品信息
product_details AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name
    FROM toy_products p
)

-- 最终查询并取TOP10
SELECT 
    pd.product_name AS `product_name`,
    ia.total_stock AS `stock_on_hand`
FROM inventory_aggregation ia
INNER JOIN product_details pd 
    ON ia.product_id = pd.product_id
ORDER BY ia.total_stock DESC
LIMIT 10

public_case.question: 如何找出信用卡支付成功率低于整体平均成功率的州，并找出这些州支付失败的客户邮箱地址？

source_gold_sql:
WITH customer_states AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        -- Extract state from address (assuming format: "Street, City, State")
        -- Using SQLite string functions to extract the third comma-separated part
        trim(
            substr(
                address,
                instr(substr(address, instr(address, ',') + 1), ',') + instr(address, ',') + 1
            )
        ) AS state
    FROM online_shop_customers
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        p.payment_method,
        p.transaction_status,
        cs.state
    FROM online_shop_orders o
    JOIN online_shop_payment p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN customer_states cs ON o.customer_id = cs.customer_id
),
state_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' AND transaction_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_attempts
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY state
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' AND transaction_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overall_completed,
        SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Credit Card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overall_attempts
    FROM joined_data
),
state_comparison AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        CAST(completed_count AS REAL) / CAST(total_attempts AS REAL) AS state_success_rate,
        (SELECT CAST(overall_completed AS REAL) / CAST(overall_attempts AS REAL) FROM overall_stats) AS overall_success_rate
    FROM state_stats
    WHERE total_attempts > 0
),
low_success_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM state_comparison
    WHERE state_success_rate < overall_success_rate
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.email
FROM online_shop_customers c
JOIN customer_states cs ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
JOIN low_success_states lss ON cs.state = lss.state
JOIN joined_data jd ON c.customer_id = jd.customer_id AND jd.transaction_status = 'Failed'

    SELECT
        app,

    FROM
        googleplaystore
    WHERE
        installs IS NOT NULL
        AND installs != ''
),

    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(install_num) AS median_install
    FROM (
        SELECT
            category,
            install_num,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY install_num) AS rn,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS cnt

            installs_converted
    )

        rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
    GROUP BY
        category
)

    a.app AS `应用`,
    (a.install_num * 1.0) / cm.median_install AS `倍数`
FROM
    installs_converted a
    JOIN category_median cm ON a.category = cm.category
WHERE
    a.install_num > 1000 * cm.median_install

source_gold_sql:
WITH premier_league AS (
    SELECT
        leagueid
    FROM
        football_leagues
    WHERE
        name = 'Premier League'
),
-- 筛选2015赛季英超的比赛
games_2015 AS (
    SELECT
        gameid,
        hometeamid,
        awayteamid
    FROM
        football_games
    WHERE
        season = '2015'
        AND leagueid = (
            SELECT
                leagueid
            FROM
                premier_league
        )
),
-- 获取所有头球射门记录并关联球队
head_shots_with_team AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE)) AS xgoal,
        teamid
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE)) AS xgoal,
                g.hometeamid AS teamid
            FROM
                football_shots s
                JOIN games_2015 g ON s.gameid = g.gameid
            WHERE
                s.shottype = 'Head'
            GROUP BY
                hometeamid
            UNION
            ALL
            SELECT
                AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE)) AS xgoal,
                g.awayteamid AS teamid
            FROM
                football_shots s
                JOIN games_2015 g ON s.gameid = g.gameid
            WHERE
                s.shottype = 'Head'
            GROUP BY
                awayteamid
        )
    GROUP BY
        teamid
),
-- 计算头球射门统计
head_shot_stats AS (
    SELECT
        teamid,
        AVG(CAST(xgoal AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_xg,
        COUNT(*) AS head_shot_count
    FROM
        head_shots_with_team
    WHERE
        teamid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        teamid
),
-- 计算总射门统计
total_shot_stats AS (
    SELECT
        sum(total_shot_count) AS total_shot_count,
        teamid
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_shot_count,
                g.hometeamid AS teamid
            FROM
                football_shots s
                JOIN games_2015 g ON s.gameid = g.gameid
            GROUP BY
                hometeamid
            UNION
            ALL
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS total_shot_count,
                g.awayteamid AS teamid
            FROM
                football_shots s
                JOIN games_2015 g ON s.gameid = g.gameid
            GROUP BY
                awayteamid
        )
    GROUP BY
        teamid
) -- 合并统计结果并关联球队名称
SELECT
    t.name AS `球队名称`,
    h.avg_xg AS `平均xG值`,
    h.head_shot_count / tst.total_shot_count AS `头球射门占比`
FROM
    head_shot_stats h
    JOIN total_shot_stats tst ON h.teamid = tst.teamid
    JOIN football_teams t ON h.teamid = t.teamid

WITH app_preprocessed AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        app,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(installs, '+', ''), ',', '') AS INTEGER) AS install_value,
        CASE
            WHEN rating REGEXP '^\d+(\.\d+)?$' THEN CAST(rating AS REAL)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rating_value
    FROM

    WHERE
        installs IS NOT NULL
        AND rating IS NOT NULL
        AND REPLACE(REPLACE(installs, '+', ''), ',', '') != ''
),

        COUNT(*) AS total_apps
    FROM
        app_preprocessed
    GROUP BY

),
category_median AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(rating_value) AS median_rating
    FROM (
        SELECT
            category,
            rating_value,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY rating_value) AS rn,
            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS cnt
        FROM
            app_preprocessed
        WHERE rating_value IS NOT NULL
    ) t
    WHERE rn >= cnt / 2.0 AND rn <= cnt / 2.0 + 1
    GROUP BY
        category
),
ranked_apps AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        app,
        install_value,
        rating_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY
                install_value DESC
        ) AS install_rank
    FROM
        app_preprocessed
)
SELECT
    r.category,
    r.app
FROM
    ranked_apps r
    JOIN category_counts cc ON r.category = cc.category
    JOIN category_median cm ON r.category = cm.category

WITH split_content_rating AS (
 -- SQLite does not support LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE or SPLIT directly.
 -- Assuming the data is relatively simple or using a recursive CTE to simulate split is too complex for this context,
 -- we will use a recursive CTE to split the semicolon-separated string.
 WITH RECURSIVE split_cte AS (
 SELECT 
 app,
 installs,
 rating,
 '' AS content_rating,
 content_rating || ';' AS remain
 FROM googleplaystore
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 
 app,
 installs,
 rating,
 substr(remain, 0, instr(remain, ';')) AS content_rating,
 substr(remain, instr(remain, ';') + 1) AS remain
 FROM split_cte
 WHERE remain != ''
 )
 SELECT 
 app,
 trim(content_rating) as content_rating,
 installs,
 rating
 FROM split_cte
 WHERE trim(content_rating) != ''
),
install_converted AS (
 SELECT
 app,
 content_rating,
 -- SQLite does not have regexp_replace by default, but we can assume simple replacement for ',' and '+'
 -- or assume the user has a custom function. For standard SQLite, we often chain replace.
 -- Here we simulate removing non-digits. Since standard SQLite is limited, we assume '1,000+' format.
 CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(installs, '+', ''), ',', '') AS INTEGER) AS installs_num,
 CAST(rating AS REAL) AS rating_num
 FROM
 split_content_rating
 WHERE
 -- Simulating: regexp_replace(installs, '[^0-9]', '') != ''
 REPLACE(REPLACE(installs, '+', ''), ',', '') != ''
 -- Simulating: rating rlike '^[0-9\.]+$'. SQLite uses GLOB or LIKE, but ISNUMERIC isn't standard.
 -- We rely on CAST returning valid numbers or NULL/0 if invalid, or use a simple check.
 AND typeof(CAST(rating AS REAL)) IN ('integer', 'real')
),
ranked_apps AS (
 SELECT
 content_rating,
 app,
 installs_num,
 rating_num,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
 PARTITION BY content_rating
 ORDER BY
 installs_num DESC
 ) AS rank
 FROM
 install_converted
)

 app AS 应用,
 rating_num AS 评分

source_gold_sql:
WITH filtered_disputed AS (
  SELECT
    countryCode,
    customerID,
    InvoiceDate,
    PaperlessDate
  FROM
    finance_factoring_data
  WHERE
    Disputed = 'Yes'
),
date_conversion AS (
  SELECT
    countryCode,
    customerID,
    -- Parse dates from M/D/YYYY or MM/D/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY format
    CASE 
      WHEN InvoiceDate LIKE '%/%/%' THEN
        date(
          substr(InvoiceDate, -4) || '-' ||
          substr('0' || substr(InvoiceDate, 1, instr(InvoiceDate, '/') - 1), -2) || '-' ||
          substr('0' || substr(substr(InvoiceDate, instr(InvoiceDate, '/') + 1), 1, 
                 instr(substr(InvoiceDate, instr(InvoiceDate, '/') + 1), '/') - 1), -2)
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS invoice_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN PaperlessDate LIKE '%/%/%' THEN
        date(
          substr(PaperlessDate, -4) || '-' ||
          substr('0' || substr(PaperlessDate, 1, instr(PaperlessDate, '/') - 1), -2) || '-' ||
          substr('0' || substr(substr(PaperlessDate, instr(PaperlessDate, '/') + 1), 1, 
                 instr(substr(PaperlessDate, instr(PaperlessDate, '/') + 1), '/') - 1), -2)
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS paperless_date
  FROM
    filtered_disputed
  WHERE
    InvoiceDate IS NOT NULL
    AND PaperlessDate IS NOT NULL
),
days_filter AS (
  SELECT
    countryCode,
    customerID,
    -- Calculate days difference using julianday
    CAST(julianday(paperless_date) - julianday(invoice_date) AS INTEGER) AS diff_days
  FROM
    date_conversion
  WHERE
    invoice_date IS NOT NULL
    AND paperless_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(julianday(paperless_date) - julianday(invoice_date) AS INTEGER) > 30
)
SELECT
  countryCode AS countrycode,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customerID) AS customer_count
FROM
  days_filter
GROUP BY
  countryCode
ORDER BY
  countryCode

source_gold_sql:
WITH filtered_apps AS (
 SELECT
 category,
 android_ver
 FROM
 googleplaystore
 WHERE
 -- SQLite 适配：由于 SQLite 没有原生的 REGEXP_EXTRACT 和 SPLIT 函数
 -- 我们利用 substr, instr 和 CAST 的特性来提取版本号
 CASE
 -- instr 找到 '-' 的位置，substr 截取其后的字符串，TRIM 去除空格
 -- CAST 转换为 REAL 时会自动解析开头的数字部分，忽略后续非数字字符
 WHEN android_ver LIKE '%-%' THEN CAST(
 TRIM(substr(android_ver, instr(android_ver, '-') + 1))
 AS REAL)
 -- 直接 CAST 会解析出 4.03，满足比较需求
 ELSE CAST(android_ver AS REAL)
 END >= 4.1
)
SELECT
 category AS 类别,
 COUNT(*) AS 应用数
FROM
 filtered_apps
GROUP BY
 category

public_case.question: 在西甲联赛中，射门转化率（进球数/射正数）超过50%的球员有哪些？

source_gold_sql:
WITH la_liga AS (
    SELECT
        leagueid
    FROM
        football_leagues
    where
        understatnotation = 'La_liga'
),
player_shots_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.playerid,
        -- 从 appearances 表提取球员ID
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN s.shotresult = 'Goal' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS goals,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN s.shotresult IN ('SavedShot', 'Goal') THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS shots_on_target
    FROM
        football_appearances a
        JOIN la_liga l ON a.leagueid = l.leagueid
        JOIN football_shots s ON a.gameid = s.gameid
        AND a.playerid = s.shooterid
    GROUP BY
        a.playerid -- 确保按 appearances 表中的 playerid 分组
)
SELECT
    p.name AS `球员姓名`,
    (stats.goals * 1.0 / stats.shots_on_target) AS `射门转化率`
FROM
    player_shots_stats stats
    JOIN football_players p ON stats.playerid = p.playerid
WHERE
    stats.shots_on_target > 0
    AND (stats.goals * 1.0 / stats.shots_on_target) > 0.5

        leagueid
    FROM
        football_leagues
    WHERE
        name = 'Premier League'
),
premier_2015_games AS (
    SELECT
        gameid,
        hometeamid,
        CAST(homegoals AS DOUBLE) AS homegoals,
        CAST(awaygoals AS DOUBLE) AS awaygoals
    FROM
        football_games
    WHERE
        leagueid = (
            SELECT
                leagueid
            FROM
                league
        )
        AND season = '2015'
),
home_wins AS (
    SELECT
        hometeamid,
        gameid,
        homegoals
    FROM
        premier_2015_games
    WHERE
        homegoals > awaygoals
),
league_avg_goals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(homegoals + awaygoals) / COUNT(DISTINCT gameid) AS avg_goals
    FROM
        premier_2015_games
),
team_goals_stats AS (
    SELECT
        hw.hometeamid,
        SUM(hw.homegoals) / COUNT(DISTINCT hw.gameid) AS team_avg_goals
    FROM
        home_wins hw
    GROUP BY
        hw.hometeamid
    HAVING
        SUM(hw.homegoals) / COUNT(DISTINCT hw.gameid) > (
            SELECT
                avg_goals
            FROM
                league_avg_goals
        )
),
qualified_teams AS (

        distinct tgs.hometeamid,
        ft.name AS `球队名称`,
        tgs.team_avg_goals AS `场均进球`
    FROM
        team_goals_stats tgs
        JOIN football_teams ft ON tgs.hometeamid = ft.teamid
),
player_assist_stats AS (
    SELECT
        q.hometeamid,
        ap.playerid,
        SUM(CAST(ap.assists AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(ap.time AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS `助攻效率`
    FROM
        football_appearances ap
        JOIN home_wins hw ON ap.gameid = hw.gameid
        JOIN qualified_teams q ON hw.hometeamid = q.hometeamid
    GROUP BY
        q.hometeamid,
        ap.playerid
)
SELECT
    distinct qt.`球队名称`,
    qt.`场均进球`,
    fp.name AS `球员名称`,
    pas.`助攻效率`
FROM
    player_assist_stats pas
    JOIN football_players fp ON pas.playerid = fp.playerid
    JOIN qualified_teams qt ON pas.hometeamid = qt.hometeamid
WHERE
    pas.`助攻效率` IS NOT NULL
    and pas.`助攻效率` > 0
ORDER BY
    qt.`场均进球` DESC,

with data_prep as (
    select 
        code,
        cast(year as int) as year,
        cast(broadband_subscription as double) as broadband_subscription,
        cast(cellular_subscription as double) as cellular_subscription
    from 
        internet_users_data

        and broadband_subscription is not null 
        and cellular_subscription is not null
),
prev_year_data as (
    select 
        code,
        year,
        broadband_subscription,
        cellular_subscription,
        lag(broadband_subscription) over (partition by code order by year) as prev_broadband,
        lag(cellular_subscription) over (partition by code order by year) as prev_cellular,

    from 
        data_prep
),
growth_rates as (

        year,
        (broadband_subscription - prev_broadband) / prev_broadband * 100 as broadband_growth,
        (cellular_subscription - prev_cellular) / prev_cellular * 100 as cellular_growth
    from 
        prev_year_data
    where 
        prev_year is not null 
        and prev_broadband is not null 
        and prev_cellular is not null 
        and year = prev_year + 1
),
annual_comparison as (

        code,
        year,
        case when broadband_growth > cellular_growth then 1 else 0 end as is_higher
    from 
        growth_rates
),
consecutive_years as (

        year,
        is_higher,
        lag(is_higher) over (partition by code order by year) as prev_is_higher

    FROM

),
-- 使用 RANK() 计算支付金额的排名

    FROM

    ride_id AS `ride_id`,
    actual_fare AS `实际支付金额`
FROM

WHERE
    payment_rank <= 5 -- 只选择前五个排名

source_gold_sql:
WITH -- 获取英超2015赛季比赛基础信息
premier_league_games AS (
    SELECT
        g.date,
        g.gameid,
        g.hometeamid,
        g.awayteamid,
        CAST(g.homegoals AS BIGINT) AS homegoals,
        CAST(g.awaygoals AS BIGINT) AS awaygoals
    FROM
        football_games g
    WHERE
        g.leagueid = '1'
        AND g.season = '2015'
),
-- 关联主队信息
home_teams AS (
    SELECT
        t.teamid,
        t.name
    FROM
        football_teams t
),
-- 关联客队信息
away_teams AS (
    SELECT
        t.teamid,
        t.name
    FROM
        football_teams t
),
-- 构建完整比赛视图
complete_games AS (
    SELECT
        p.date,
        ht.teamid AS hometeamid,
        at.teamid AS awayteamid,
        ht.name AS home_team,
        at.name AS away_team,
        p.homegoals,
        p.awaygoals,
        (p.homegoals + p.awaygoals) AS total_goals
    FROM
        premier_league_games p
        JOIN home_teams ht ON p.hometeamid = ht.teamid
        JOIN away_teams at ON p.awayteamid = at.teamid
),
-- 计算球队平均进球
team_avg_goals AS (
    SELECT
        teamid,
        AVG(goals) AS avg_goals
    FROM
        (
            SELECT
                hometeamid AS teamid,
                homegoals AS goals
            FROM
                football_games
            WHERE
                leagueid = '1'
                AND season = '2015'
            UNION
            ALL
            SELECT
                awayteamid AS teamid,
                awaygoals AS goals
            FROM
                football_games
            WHERE
                leagueid = '1'
                AND season = '2015'
        ) combined
    GROUP BY
        teamid
),
ranked_games AS (
    SELECT
        c.date,
        c.home_team,
        c.away_team,
        c.total_goals,
        t1.avg_goals AS home_avg_goals,
        t2.avg_goals AS away_avg_goals,
        -- 关键修改：使用RANK()实现跳过名次
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                c.total_goals DESC
        ) AS goals_rank
    FROM
        complete_games c
        JOIN team_avg_goals t1 ON c.hometeamid = t1.teamid
        JOIN team_avg_goals t2 ON c.awayteamid = t2.teamid
)
SELECT
    date AS `date`,
    home_team AS `home_team`,
    away_team AS `away_team`,
    total_goals AS `total_goals`,
    home_avg_goals AS `home_avg_goals`,
    away_avg_goals AS `away_avg_goals`
FROM
    ranked_games
WHERE
    goals_rank <= 5 -- 前五名（含并列）
ORDER BY
    goals_rank,
    date

WITH ride_promo AS (
    SELECT
        r.city,
        CASE
            WHEN r.promo_code IS NOT NULL
            AND r.promo_code != '' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_promo,
        CAST(d.experience_years AS DOUBLE) AS experience
    FROM
        city_ride_rides_data r
        INNER JOIN city_ride_drivers_data d ON r.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
city_stats AS (

        COUNT(*) AS total_rides,
        SUM(is_promo) AS promo_rides,
        AVG(experience) AS avg_experience
    FROM
        ride_promo
    GROUP BY
        city
)
SELECT
    city AS `城市`,
    promo_rides / total_rides AS `使用优惠码的行程占比`,
    avg_experience AS `司机平均驾龄`
FROM
    city_stats

public_case.question: 找出2015赛季英超联赛中每场比赛中射门次数最多且助攻次数超过1次的球员

source_gold_sql:
with epl_league as (
    select
        leagueid
    from
        football_leagues
    where
        understatnotation = 'EPL'
),
games_2015_epl as (
    select
        gameid
    from
        football_games
    where
        season = '2015'
        and leagueid in (
            select
                leagueid
            from
                epl_league
        )
),
player_stats as (
    select
        a.gameid,
        a.playerid,
        sum(cast(a.assists as int)) as total_assists,
        sum(cast(a.shots as int)) as total_shots
    from
        football_appearances a
    where
        a.gameid in (
            select
                gameid
            from
                games_2015_epl
        )
    group by
        a.gameid,
        a.playerid
    having
        sum(cast(a.assists as int)) > 1
),
ranked_players as (
    select
        gameid,
        playerid,
        total_shots,
        row_number() over (
            partition by gameid
            order by
                total_shots desc
        ) as rank
    from
        player_stats
),
final_players as (
    select
        r.gameid,
        r.playerid,
        p.name as `player_name`
    from
        ranked_players r
        join football_players p on r.playerid = p.playerid
    where
        r.rank = 1
),
team_mapping as (
    select
        g.gameid,
        t.teamid,
        t.name as `team_name`
    from
        football_games g
        join football_teams t on g.hometeamid = t.teamid
    union
    all
    select
        g.gameid,
        t.teamid,
        t.name as `team_name`
    from
        football_games g
        join football_teams t on g.awayteamid = t.teamid
),
player_teams as (
    select
        distinct a.gameid,
        a.playerid,
        tm.team_name
    from
        football_appearances a
        join team_mapping tm on a.gameid = tm.gameid
)
select
    distinct fp.gameid,
    fp.player_name
from
    final_players fp
    join player_teams pt on fp.gameid = pt.gameid
    and fp.playerid = pt.playerid

public_case.question: 如何识别在店铺中销售额增长的玩具产品以及对应的月份？

source_gold_sql:
WITH      residential_stores AS (
          SELECT    store_id
          FROM      toy_stores
          ),
          sales_data AS (
          SELECT    s.product_id,
                    SUBSTR(s.date, 1, 7) AS sale_month,
                    SUM(
                    CAST(s.units AS INT) * CAST(
                    REPLACE   (TRIM(p.product_price), '$', '') AS DOUBLE
                    )
                    ) AS monthly_sales
          FROM      toy_sales s
          JOIN      residential_stores rs ON s.store_id = rs.store_id
          JOIN      toy_products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
          GROUP BY  s.product_id,
                    SUBSTR(s.date, 1, 7)
          ),
          sales_growth AS (
          SELECT    product_id,
                    sale_month,
                    monthly_sales,
                    LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY product_id
                    ORDER BY  sale_month
                    ) AS prev_sales
          FROM      sales_data
          )
SELECT    DISTINCT product_id AS `product_id`,
          sale_month AS `sale_month`
FROM      (
          SELECT    product_id,
                    sale_month,
                    CASE
                              WHEN monthly_sales > prev_sales THEN 1
                              ELSE 0
                    END AS is_growing
          FROM      sales_growth
          ) t
WHERE     is_growing = 1

public_case.question: 统计每个产品类别中运费超过平均运价的商品销量排名

source_gold_sql:
WITH 
avg_shipping_charge AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CAST(shipping_charges AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_shipping
    FROM 
        ecommerce_order_items
),
high_shipping_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        order_items.product_id,
        CAST(order_items.price AS DOUBLE) AS price_val
    FROM 
        ecommerce_order_items order_items
    WHERE 
        CAST(order_items.shipping_charges AS DOUBLE) > (SELECT avg_shipping FROM avg_shipping_charge)
),
product_category_data AS (
    SELECT 
        products.product_id,
        products.product_category_name
    FROM 
        ecommerce_products products
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        pcd.product_category_name AS `产品类别`,
        SUM(hso.price_val) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_count
    FROM 
        high_shipping_orders hso
    INNER JOIN 
        product_category_data pcd 
    ON 
        hso.product_id = pcd.product_id
    GROUP BY 
        pcd.product_category_name
)
SELECT 
    `产品类别`,
    total_sales AS `总销售额`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS `销售排名`
FROM 
    category_sales
ORDER BY 
    `销售排名` ASC

public_case.question: 统计各品类商品在不同支付方式下的销售额，品类平均销售额

source_gold_sql:
WITH sales_by_category_payment AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.payment_method,
        SUM(
            CAST(oi.quantity AS DOUBLE) * CAST(oi.unit_price AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS sales
    FROM
        blinkit_order_items oi
        JOIN blinkit_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
        JOIN blinkit_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY
        p.category,
        o.payment_method
),
category_avg AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(sales) AS avg_sales
    FROM
        sales_by_category_payment
    GROUP BY
        category
)
SELECT
    scp.category AS `品类`,
    scp.payment_method AS `支付方式`,
    scp.sales AS `销售额`,
    ca.avg_sales AS `品类平均销售额`
FROM
    sales_by_category_payment scp
    JOIN category_avg ca ON scp.category = ca.category

    FROM
        toy_stores

    FROM
        toy_inventory
    GROUP BY
        store_id
),
turnover_rates AS (

        vs.store_id,
        (vs.total_units * 1.0) / si.total_stock AS turnover_rate,
        st.store_city
    FROM
        valid_sales vs

        JOIN toy_stores st ON vs.store_id = st.store_id
),

public_case.question: 电子产品类目中每个卖家的总销售额与运费的比例最高的是哪位？

source_gold_sql:
WITH electronic_products AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM ecommerce_products
    WHERE product_category_name = 'electronics'
),
seller_financials AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(CAST(oi.price AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales,
        SUM(CAST(oi.shipping_charges AS DOUBLE)) AS total_shipping
    FROM ecommerce_order_items oi
    INNER JOIN electronic_products ep 
        ON oi.product_id = ep.product_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING total_shipping > 0
)
SELECT 
    seller_id as `卖家ID`,
    total_sales / total_shipping as `销售运费比`
FROM seller_financials
ORDER BY `销售运费比` DESC
LIMIT 1

public_case.question: 找出旅游业收入占GDP比例超过5%且总旅游收益超过5亿美元的国家，并显示其对应的腐败指数和失业率

source_gold_sql:
with tourism_data as (
    select 
        country,
        cast(percentage_of_gdp as double) as percentage_of_gdp,
        cast(receipts_in_billions as double) as receipts_in_billions
    from world_economic_tourism
),
unemployment_data as (
    select 
        country,
        cast(unemployment_rate as double) as unemployment_rate
    from world_economic_unemployment
),
corruption_data as (
    select 
        country,
        cast(corruption_index as double) as corruption_index
    from world_economic_corruption
)

select
    t.country as `country`,
    c.corruption_index as `corruption_index`,
    u.unemployment_rate as `unemployment_rate`
from tourism_data t
join unemployment_data u on t.country = u.country
join corruption_data c on u.country = c.country
where
    t.receipts_in_billions > 0.5 and t.percentage_of_gdp > 0.05
